offboard: Photo not accepted: use the onboard camera.
tooFar: Photo not accepted: too far from the target.
tooClose: Photo not accepted: too close to capture the full target.
murky: Photo not accepted: visibility too low to see the target.
offFrame: Photo not accepted: target is not in frame.
noTarget: Photo saved, but no pending deliverable nearby.
angleDrift: Shot angle drifted from the reference
